chapters.label: Live: the 2014 final
chapters.text: The 2014 UEFA Futsal Cup final, in Baku. Barcelona play Dynamo, and Dynamo lead one nil. Then Gabriel, from Brazil, rifles in the equaliser from far out! Barça win five two in extra time.

chapters.label: How he defends
chapters.text: Gabriel was strong in defence too. This is how he tackles: he gets close to the attacker, fast. He stays low, knees bent. He watches the ball, not the tricks. Then he steps in and takes it cleanly!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Close, low, clean!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: get close, stay low and take the ball cleanly!
